author: codex-ai-model-pilot
method: Areas measured from frozen polygons after projection to each raster UTM CRS; geographic edges densified at <=0.00001 degree before projection. No pixel-center count used as continuous polygon area.

Three scope changes after catalog exposure are audited: STC fondeo land excluded at second raw review, PRQ patios numerical zero-area residue normalized to abstention, and PRQ muelles small positive-only window added around a new second-review reference. All three observations had zero catalog proposals.
Per-zone rows can overlap. Per-port/acquisition unions remove zone overlap before area-time aggregation.
Abstention means no reviewed area and no claim about boat absence. Dates retained unchanged.
Negative scope means no visually unambiguous vessels in that explicit area at this resolution; small-vessel completeness unestablished.
PBR visual positive windows were fixed outside automatic cloud mask before proposal exposure; quality mask is unchanged and second-review adjudication required.
No land/water segmentation was added; terrestrial areas are not presented as marine coverage.
No model metrics, calibration, training, inference or test inspection performed.
